summary: Typosquat of @tailwindcss/forms ships obfuscated import-time payload with child_process + Ethereum RPC C2
details: tailwindcss-contact-forms impersonates the official @tailwindcss/forms plugin: package.json falsely claims https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss-forms as its repository and the README is copied from the Tailwind Labs plugin. src/index.js prepends legitimate tailwindcss-forms code as camouflage and appends an obfuscator.io-style payload (301-entry rotated string array, hex identifiers _0xNNNN, decoder _0x462e, 495 inline-decoder-wrappers). Decoded strings reference node:child_process, node:zlib (createBrotliDecompress), HTTP verbs (GET/HEAD), custom X-Payload-B6 headers, and Ethereum JSON-RPC endpoints/methods (mainnet, h.blockscout, h.drpc.org, eth_getBlock). The payload is reachable via the package main and executes when any consumer requires the module, giving the publisher code execution on the installer's host through an on-chain C2 / wallet-drainer style loader. A CSS utility plugin has no legitimate need for child_process, Brotli decompression of HTTP payloads, or Ethereum RPC traffic.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
